question: The ‘Sepahijala Wildlife Sanctuary’ is located in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tripura.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sepahijala Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Indian State **Tripura.**
 
• The Size of this Wildlife Sanctuary is 18.53 square kilometres.
 
• It is a woodland that includes an artificial lake and natural botanical and zoological gardens.
 
• It is the Biggest Wildlife Sanctuary in **Tripura.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• There is a total of **565** existing wildlife sanctuaries in India.
 
• **Some of the Wildlife Sanctuaries are:**
 
 
• **​__****Manas National Park or Manas Wildlife Sanctuary** 
 
• **Parambikulam Wildlife Sanctuary**
 
• **Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand.**
 
• **Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, Kerala.**
 
• **Sundarbans National Park, West Bengal.**
 
• **Kaziranga National Park, Assam.**
 
• **Ranthambore National Park, Rajasthan.**
 
• **Kanha National Park, Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• **Bandipur National Park, Karnataka**
